heading: Establishment of block grant program
lead: The Secretary is authorized to make grants to States in accordance with the provisions of this subchapter.

notes.text: Amendments1992—Pub. L. 102–401 and Pub. L. 102–586 made identical technical corrections to directory language of Pub. L. 101–508, § 5082(2), which added this section.
